title: Measured PCB enclosure shell
task: Create project 'eval-enclosure'. Measured component: PCB 70×50×12 mm. Internal clearance 1.5 mm each side. Wall thickness 2.0 mm (stated assumption). Build an open-top enclosure shell sized from the measured board + clearance + walls. Add a 12×6 mm USB opening centered on the front wall, 3 mm up from the floor. Validate, preview, and export STEP or FCStd. Do not invent dimensions; use only the values given.
